topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation within the Biology of Disease course.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition by Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the molecular principles and receptor pathways used by the innate immune system to detect microbial products and cellular damage.

topics.label: Leukocyte Recruitment and Systemic Inflammatory Dynamics
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how activated sentinel cells direct immune cell migration through tissues and the lymphatic system, as well as the physiological hazards of uncontrolled systemic inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: They address the mechanisms responsible for terminating acute inflammation and restoring damaged tissue, alongside the causes and protective adaptations of persistent chronic inflammation.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture session and announces the subject of the following lecture.
